comparison.objective: Share one trash can during disposal work, rather than fracture and contain HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated transport and disposal into a shared receptacle versus coaxial tooling, controlled impact, and recovery of tiny metal fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies successful shared disposal; referenced task details are absent and no rubric is included. Generic containment/disposal does not establish the candidate's four physical fractures and insert-safety requirements.
comparison.reason: A shared receptacle is only a generic primitive; the central tested ability lacks notch fracture and retained-insert protection.
